title: At-Tin 95:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-'Alaq 13 to 19, At-Tin and meem sakinah
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 22 (Pupil PDF worksheet: At-Tin 95:1-3 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 22. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ (١) وَطُورِ سِينِينَ (٢) وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ (٣)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: By the fig and the olive

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Sun letter: ز; madd at the end
At a stop: madd 'arid, 2 to 6 counts
Moon letter: ب; laam is said

questions.q: Chunk and link At-Tin 95:1-3 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 95:1-3 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 95:1-3 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF, circle every sun letter and box every moon letter in 95:1 to 3.
questions.a: Sun: وَٱلتِّينِ and وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ; moon: ٱلْبَلَدِ and ٱلْأَمِينِ.

questions.q: Explain why Makkah is called 'this secure city' (95:3).
questions.a: Allah made it a safe, sacred place where fighting and harm are forbidden.

questions.q: Which two foods are named in 95:1?
questions.a: A) The fig and the olive. 95:1: 'By the fig and the olive'.

questions.q: Think again: Allah swears by the fig, the olive, a mountain and a city. Why might Allah swear by things we can see and touch?
questions.a: To make us notice His blessings and the special places linked to His messengers, and to think.
